'''Shady Glen Estates''' was an apartment complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was located in the [[Justicar territory|territory]] of the paramilitary [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] group known as the [[Justicars' Brigade]].
